title: Dhisayaashii Tiirarka Sare
intro: Waxaad taagan tahay burburka magaalo qadiimi ah oo qurux badan, tiirarkeedii dhaadheeraa hadda way dhaceen. Dabayshu waxay ka qaylinaysaa waddooyinka madhan, iyadoo sidda xusuusta dad xooggan oo mar xukumi jiray dhulalkan. Yaa ahaayeen?
clues: Waxaan ahayn dad xoog iyo xirfad aad u badan leh, oo caan ku ah dhismayaasheenna waaweyn iyo ilbaxnimada horumarsan.
Waxaan ku noolayn dhul ciid iyo buuro dhagax leh, waxaana aaminsanayn in cidina naga adkaan karto.
Rasuul baa noo yimid oo ka mid ah ehelkeenna, isagoo noogu yeeraya inaan caabudno Alle oo keliya, laakiin waan diidnay oo ku jeesjeesnay.
Waxaan ku faannay, 'Yaa naga xoog badan?' ka dibna waxaan sii wadnay isla weynidii iyo caabudiddii sanamyada.
Ilaahay wuxuu nagu soo diray dabayl xooggan oo socotay toddobo habeen iyo siddeed maalmood, taasoo wax walba burburisay.
Waxaan ahayn dadkii Caad, dhisayaashii Iraam, qaddarkeennuna wuxuu noqday digniin dhammaan kuwa ka dambeeya.

trial.label: Ciqaabtii loo soo jeediyay maxay ahayd?

location.label: Waa maxay magaca magaaladooda halyeeyga ah?

outcome.label: Maxay ahayd qaddarkooda ugu dambeeya?
options: Way burbureen, haraadigoodiina cashar buu noqday
Way toobad keeneen oo way badbaadeen
Waxaa lagu aasay dhul-go' ka dib markii dhul-go' uu ku dhacay
outcome.answer: Way burbureen, haraadigoodiina cashar buu noqday

arabic: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَـٰكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verse: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people. (46:25)
